title: The Loot
subtitle: One table, rolled at claim
description: The quest here pays out of a reward table. Its `tasked:loot` reward names
`reward_tables/loot.json`, and the table is rolled when the reward is
collected -- which can come up empty, because `emptyWeight` is the chance
of nothing and `loot` includes it where `random` promises something.
The weight-zero entry is the other rule worth reading: zero means always
granted, once per roll, which is how a table says "and everyone also gets
this" without taking a share of the probability.
